info.title: CSR Budgeting API
info.summary: National CSR budget allocation, project monitoring and analysis API.
info.description: Backend for "سامانه جامع و ملی مدیریت هوشمند توسعه روستایی و شهری" — a Persian-language budget-allocation and executive-project monitoring platform. All money is Toman/Rial (1 Toman = 10 Rial). Sessions use an httpOnly access-token cookie (`csr_at`, HS256 JWT, default 15 min) plus a rotating httpOnly refresh cookie (`csr_rt`, path=/api/auth, default 30 d); machine clients may send the access JWT as `Authorization: Bearer`. Errors are always `{ "error": <message>, "code"?: <machine-code> }`.

post.summary: Log in with mobile number + password
post.description: Verifies credentials and issues a session (sets `csr_at` + `csr_rt` cookies). The mobile is normalized server-side (Persian/Arabic digits, `+98`/`0098`/`98 9…`/`9…` → canonical `09xxxxxxxxx`). Wrong mobile and wrong password are indistinguishable (401 `AUTH_REQUIRED`). Rate limited to 8 attempts / 60 s / IP.

post.summary: Exchange the refresh cookie for a fresh session
post.description: Requires the `csr_rt` httpOnly cookie (path /api/auth). The presented token is consumed ("rotation") and a successor token in the same rotation family is issued together with a new access token. Presenting an already-consumed or revoked token revokes the entire family (theft containment). A fresh `csr_rt` cookie is NOT obtained here — the new refresh token is only available via the `Set-Cookie` header of this response.

401.description: Missing/expired/replayed refresh token (`AUTH_REQUIRED` or `SESSION_REVOKED`) or disabled account (`ACCOUNT_DISABLED`). Cookies are cleared on these responses.

post.summary: Revoke the current refresh-token family and clear cookies
post.description: Idempotent: always 200, even with no cookie present. Revokes the whole rotation family belonging to the presented `csr_rt`, then clears both cookies.

post.summary: Allocate the budget across priorities (Toman + Rial)
post.description: Reads the stored priorities; per priority uses an explicit allocation from the request when provided, otherwise the stored `defaultPercentage`. `totalBudgetToman` may be omitted to use the organization's stored `totalBudget`.

post.summary: Rule-based smart percentage recommendation per priority
post.description: Runs the local recommendation engine on the given deprivation `indicators` (defaults to the first stored location's indicators) and returns scores + explainability per priority target.
